big.description: Whether to use the big tag style

value.description: Value of the tag, used as the inner text or HTML in lieu of children

color.description: Color variant for the tag (e.g., null, 'primary', 'accent-cool', 'blue', 'base', etc.)

icon.description: Name of the icon to display before the tag text, from the USWDS sprite (e.g., 'check', 'close', 'warning', etc.)

className.description: Additional classes to add to the tag

children.description: Inner HTML or text for the tag
